venue.name: Christ Church Cathedral
venue.description: Christ Church Cathedral is an Anglican cathedral at 930 Burdett Avenue in Victoria, BC, and is the episcopal seat of the Anglican Diocese of British Columbia. The Gothic-style building, designed by J.C.M. Keith and consecrated in stages between 1929 and 1991, is open to visitors daily and periodically offers guided tours of its nave, chapels and stained glass.
venue.hours_notes: The Cathedral is open to visitors 8.30 a.m. - 5.30 p.m. on weekdays, 10.00 a.m. - 4.00 p.m. on Saturdays, and 7.30 a.m. - 5.00 p.m. on Sundays. Parish office hours are Monday to Thursday 10 am - 3 pm.
venue.seasonal_notes: During the summer a combined service is held at 10.30 a.m. each Sunday. The 2023 guided-tour announcement said tours took place regularly in August and September.

programs.name: Discover the Cathedral guided tour
programs.description: Guided tour of the Gothic cathedral covering the nave, chapels, architecture, war history and stained glass collection. The announcement page is dated July 20, 2023 and states the first tour was Tuesday, August 1 at 10.30am with tours running regularly in August and September; tickets were sold through Eventbrite (an off-site partner). No current-season schedule, price, group rate or minimum age is published on the Cathedral's own site.
programs.evidence: Tour our grand Gothic cathedral and hear the tales of how it was created and the history of the people involved.

programs.name: School group visit and tour
programs.description: The Cathedral states it hosts senior students from local high schools studying Comparative Cultures each year; the visit includes a tour of the cathedral given by clergy plus a brief description of Anglicanism and how it relates to other major religions. The page is a June 10, 2023 news item; no booking page, price, group size limit or lead time is published.
programs.evidence: Christ Church Cathedral plays host every year to senior students from local high schools who are studying Comparative Cultures.

programs.name: Self-guided visit
programs.description: The Cathedral is open daily to visitors during posted hours for worship, prayer, meditation or just to visit. No admission price, group rate or group booking requirement is stated on the site.
programs.evidence: The Cathedral is open to visitors from 8.30am - 5.30pm on weekdays. 10.00am - 4pm on Saturdays.

gaps: No price is published for guided tours; the only ticket link goes to an off-site Eventbrite page which was not opened.
No youngest age, capacity maximum or lead time for group or school visits is stated anywhere on the site.
There is no schools/education/field-trip section; the only school-visit evidence is a 2023 news item, so it is unclear whether school tours are still offered or how to request one.
No statement about washrooms, lunch/eating space or a place for a group to leave coats and bags.
Accessibility (wheelchair, stroller) is not described anywhere on the site.
Bus parking is not addressed; the site only notes street parking on Quadra Street, Burdett Avenue and Rockland Avenue plus parking at the south entrance off Burdett.
The tours landing page https://www.christchurchcathedral.bc.ca/programs/discover-the-cathedral redirects to a login screen, so any current tour details on it could not be read.
Facility rental for meetings and workshops exists but no rates are on the web page; they may be in the linked 'CCC Facilities Use Policy 2025.pdf', which was not opened.
